CRIMINAL APPLICATION (ABA) NO.410 OF 2024  (Huzaif Khan Rauf Khan and anr. Vs. State of Maharashtra)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

sentences.text:
CORAM:- URMILA JOSHI-PHALKE, J.
DATED :- JUNE 12, 2024.
Heard.
2. By this application, the applicant is seeking pre-arrest bail.

The applicant is apprehending arrest at the hands of police in connection with Crime No.149/2024 registered with police station Nagpuri Gate, Amaravati, District Amravati for the offence punishable under Sections 420 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, Sections 51, 52, 63 and 68 of the Copyright Act, 1957 along with Sections 103 and 104 of the Trade Marks Act, 1999.

3. The accusation against the present applicants is on the basis of report lodged by one Vijay Uttamrao Pawar who claims to be the Field Officer of Netrika Consultancy Pvt. Ltd. which has been authorised by the Hindustan Unilever Limited to keep watch on any activity relating to the copyright and trademark infringement in the State of Maharashtra of the products of Hindustan Unilever Ltd.

It is alleged that on 21/04/2024, the complainant had received information that the duplicate stock of Wheel Detergent Powder and Rin Soap is recovered and the said stock was shown to the complainant and upon instructions it was noticed that these products are not of Hindustan Unilever Ltd.
but the applicants have contravened the provisions of the Copyright Act and the Trade Marks Act and cheated the public at large.
4. Learned Counsel for the applicant submitted that as far as the custodial interrogation of the present applicants is concerned which is not required as entire stock is already recovered.
As far as interrogation part is concerned the applicants have ready to cooperate with the investigating agency.
He further submitted that entire investigation is around the documentary evidence.

In view of that,
they be protected by granting ad-interim protection.

1 5. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor strongly opposed the application on the ground that only contravention of the provisions of the Trade Marks Act and the Copyright Act but the intention of the present applicants needs to be taken into consideration, and therefore, prayer for grant of ad-interim protection deserves to be rejected.
6. I have heard learned Counsel for both the parties.
Perused the recitals of the FIR from which it reveals that some stock is recovered showing that it was the stock of Wheel Detergent Powder and Rin Soap which is a product of Hindustan Unilever Ltd.
As far as the custodial interrogation is concerned, at this stage, nothing is on record to show that the immediate custodial interrogation is required.
The offences punishable are up to the seven years imprisonment, and therefore, the compliance under Section 41 and 41(A) by the investigating officer is required which is absent in the present case.
Considering all these aspects at this stage, immediate custodial interrogation is not required, therefore, the applicants can be protected by granting ad- interim protection.

Accordingly,
I proceed to pass following order:
(i) Issue notice to the non-applicant, returnable after two weeks.
(ii) Learned APP waives notice for the State.

(iii) In the event of arrest, the applicants - 1) Huzaif Khan Rauf Khan and 2) Samir Baig Jamir Baig in connection with Crime No.149/2024 registered with police station Nagpuri Gate, Amaravati, District Amravati for the offence punishable under Sections 420 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, Sections 51, 52, 63 and 68 of the Copyright Act, 1957 along with Sections 103 and 104 of the Trademark Act, 1999, be released on ad-interim anticipatory bail on executing a P.R.Bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- each with one solvent surety each, in the like amount.
(iv) The applicants shall attend the concerned police station as and when required for the investigation purpose and shall cooperate with the investigating agency.
(v) The applicants shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement and threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the present case.

(URMILA JOSHI-PHALKE, J.) *Divya Huzaif Khan Rauf Khan And Another vs The State Of Mah. Thr. Pso Ps Nagpuri Gae ... on 12 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/134155667/
